results.actorResponse:
Moldea is a system for maintaining Git-owned project context and agent configurations—canonical project knowledge, agent definitions, relationships, requirements, and mirrors—without taking over ordinary engineering workflows.

Initialize it when you explicitly want a repository to adopt that durable, version-controlled context system. Good cases include long-lived projects where multiple agents need shared architectural or operational knowledge.

Don’t initialize it automatically for routine coding, reviews, one-off tasks, or repositories that don’t need persistent agent context. Until initialized, Moldea should stay out of repository work. Initialization creates only the minimum valid foundation; it shouldn’t invent metadata or relationships.
